record.Description: This recall involves Whatever Works microwave grillers. The rectangular grills have a white plastic exterior with black locking clips on the side, hinge tabs at the rear, and two non-stick black metal plates. Model K4001 can be found on the product’s purchase receipt.
record.Title: Whatever Works Recalls Microwave Grills Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard
record.ConsumerContact: Whatever Works toll-free at 877-756-5053 from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET Monday through Friday, email at help@whateverworks.com, or online at Whateverworks.com/recall or Whateverworks.com/ and click on “Customer Service/Product Recall” for more information.

Injuries.Name: The firm has received three reports of grills igniting, all resulting in fires. No injuries have been reported.

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Whateverworks.com from January 2025 through June 2026 for about $22.
Potpourri Group, Inc., dba Whatever Works, of Billerica, Massachusetts

Hazards.Name: The recalled grills can overheat and ignite, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire hazard.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled grills immediately and contact Whatever Works for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write in permanent marker “Recalled” on the grill and send a photo of the marked grill to recall@whateverworks.com. Consumers will be provided with a prepaid label to return the recalled product.
